subject: Activation Playbook & MAP Handoff — MedData Integration

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Activation Playbook & MAP Handoff — MedData Integration

Hi Daniel / Sara,

Huge thanks for signing — thrilled to have MedData on Redwood. Per our close call, I wanted to kick off the handoff to Customer Success and align next steps so we hit your evaluation targets on the timeline we discussed.

Quick summary and asks: 
- Timeline: 6-week technical evaluation window starting May 1, go/no-go review on June 12.
- Primary objectives: Validate latency under P95 SLA, run a 10k-record embedding quality test, and exercise private VPC ingestion with sample PHI-safe payloads.
- Stakeholders: you (Daniel) - product lead; Sara - infra; Tom (integration) will be technical lead.

I’m introducing Laura Bennett (Customer Success Lead) who will own onboarding and the MAP from here on out. Laura — please find attached the Activation Playbook v1 and a proposed kickoff agenda. Marissa (CC) will remain on-deck for billing/contract clarifications through initial ops.

Next practical steps: 
1) Laura to schedule a 60-min kickoff with your core group (suggest week of April 29).
2) Customer to confirm technical point-of-contact and preferred SSO/KMS approach by Apr 26.
3) Redwood to provide sandbox credentials and a short ingestion guide before kickoff.

If the dates above don’t work, say so and we’ll shift. Looking forward to a smooth activation.

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Daniel, Sara — nice to meet you over email. I’ll be your Customer Success lead for the evaluation and onboarding.

I took Vivek’s draft timeline and turned it into a short MAP we can work against — highlights below and attached a Redwood MAP template I’ll use to track owners and completion.

MAP highlights (short):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): Customer sends sample dataset + SSO/KMS decision; Redwood provides sandbox creds.
- Week 1: Kickoff + run first full sync to validate ingestion and keys.
- Week 2–3: Run performance suite (P50/P95 measurements), enable KV cache and evaluate batch settings.
- Week 4: Embedding quality run (10k records) + manual sample review.
- Week 5: Regression checks and final tuning; prepare evaluation report.
- Week 6: Final review & go/no-go.

Action items for this thread: 
- Daniel: confirm kickoff attendee list + preferred kickoff window (Apr 29–May 3) and who will own KMS decisions.
- Sara: provide IP allowlist and whether you’ll use aws-kms or an on-prem HSM (if known).
- Marissa / Vivek: share procurement contact for ordering reserved capacity (if needed early).

I’ll propose two slots for the kickoff once you confirm availability.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0244

Thanks Vivek and Laura — excited to get started.

A few clarifications from our side: 
- Kickoff: May 1 at 10:00am PT works for the group. Please send calendar invite.
- Team: Myself (product lead), Sara (cloud infra), Tom (integration), and Mei Lin (security) 
- KMS: We prefer aws-kms for the evaluation; Mei Lin will confirm key rotation policy during kickoff.
- Data: We can provide a de-identified sample set (approx 12k rows) by Apr 28.

Two asks before kickoff: 
1) Can Redwood share a short checklist of sandbox network/IPs to allowlist?
2) Do you have an example evaluation rubric you use to summarize embedding quality?

If you need anything else from procurement we’ll circle back to Marissa.

Thanks,
Daniel

- Evaluation rubric: Attached is a one-page rubric we use for embedding quality (precision/recall checks, human sample review process, and threshold guidance). We’ll run the 10k record job in Week 4 and ship the rubric and results mid-week.
